project_life_cycle.life_cycle_description: Four-phase hybrid delivery model consisting of Concept, Foundation, Incremental Sprints, and Enterprise Transition.

phase_gates.exit_criteria: Architecture Review Board sign-off and core cluster deployment verified.
Successful end-to-end sandbox dry run and user acceptance sign-off.

baselines_summary.scope_baseline_summary: Governed by WBS v2.1 encompassing core finance, procurement, and inventory management modules across 12 distribution hubs.
baselines_summary.schedule_baseline_summary: 18-month timeline with critical path through supply chain adapter certification and parallel payroll integration.
baselines_summary.cost_baseline_summary: Total approved baseline budget of $4.8M USD with 10% management reserve held at steering committee level.

governance_and_reviews.change_management_process: Formal change control board (CCB) reviews all variance requests exceeding 5 days on critical path or $25,000 cost impact.
governance_and_reviews.performance_measurement_rules: Monthly earned value management (EVM) tracking using CPI and SPI thresholds of 0.90 triggering corrective action plans.
